test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: 4 boys or 7 girls can complete a piece of work in 18 days. How many days will 12 boys and 21 girls together take to complete this job?
solution:
Given:

4 boys or 7 girls can complete a piece of work in 18 days. 

Concept used:

Total work = Number of workers × Efficiency of each worker × Days to complete the work

Calculation:

Let the efficiency of each boy and girl be B and G respectively.

According to the concept,

4B = 7G

⇒ B/G = 7/4

So, the efficiencies of each boy and girl be 7k and 4k respectively. (k = constant)

Total work = (4 × 7k × 18) units

Now, to complete the job, 12 boys and 21 girls together will take

⇒ (4 × 7k × 18) ÷ (12 × 7k + 21 × 4k)

⇒ 3 days

**∴ 12 boys and 21 girls together will take 3 days to complete this job.**
